sheets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: exercise reference thumbnail contact sheet, to be mechanically cropped into nine square exercise cards. Create exactly one 1536x1536 image with EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of nine equal square cells. No borders, gutters, labels, text, numbers, logos, arrows, or decorative graphics. Every cell has a uniform warm ivory #f5f4ef floor/background, a fully visible exercise subject and the relevant complete apparatus with comfortable margins; no equipment cut off by cell edges. Match the supplied reference person's appearance and overall instructional render style: the SAME athletic adult male, short dark hair, warm natural tan skin, plain charcoal shorts, dark gray athletic shoes, neutral charcoal/gray equipment. All scenes use consistent soft studio lighting, fixed gentle three-quarter side or front view chosen to make each exercise recognizable, medium detail with smooth consistent skin surfaces, clear color skin against gray apparatus, no pore-like noise or fabric texture. Each cell is a DIFFERENT exercise listed below, in exact row-major reading order. The input image is only a reference for the athlete, palette, light and materials; do not repeat its chest machine. Make accurate static demonstration poses and realistic gym equipment connections, no impossible limbs or floating parts. All9 cells must be separate full-body exercise scenes centered identically in their square cells.
Cell1 top-left: HIGH-TO-LOW CABLE CROSSOVER. Man standing split stance between two tall cable towers. Both high pulleys above shoulders, taut cables attached to handgrips, arms softly bent closing down diagonally toward lower chest in front. Both cable towers and full body visible.
Cell2 top-center: STANDING CABLE BICEPS CURL. Man standing facing low-pulley cable machine, palms UP on short straight bar, elbows beside ribs bent about90degrees, bar in front of waist, cable attached to low pulley near floor in front.
Cell3 top-right: PREACHER CURL. Seated at sloped preacher bench with both upper arms resting on angled pad, hands palms up holding an EZ bar, elbows flexed about70degrees, no cable machine.
Cell4 middle-left: FLOOR CRUNCH. Man lying supine on thin charcoal mat, knees bent feet planted; arms crossed lightly over chest, upper shoulders lifted slightly off mat, lower back stays down. Full body in side view.
Cell5 middle-center: REVERSE CRUNCH. Man lying supine on mat, head and shoulders resting, arms on mat beside body, hips rolled slightly up, bent knees toward chest and feet suspended. Side view, clear difference from regular crunch.
Cell6 middle-right: FOREARM PLANK. Man face down on mat, weight on both forearms and toes, elbows under shoulders, knees straight, head-to-heels one straight line. No hands-up push-up position.
Cell7 bottom-left: SEATED MACHINE SHOULDER PRESS. Man seated upright against vertical backrest on charcoal shoulder press machine, both hands on elevated handles beside head, arms pressing overhead, upper-arm motion upwards; visible resistance machine frame.
Cell8 bottom-center: STANDING DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE. Standing upright with one dumbbell in each hand, arms raised to SIDES at shoulder height, elbows softly bent. Front three-quarter view, no cables, no bench.
Cell9 bottom-right: LOW-CABLE FRONT RAISE. Standing with back to low cable pulley, holding a short bar in both hands in front of body at chest/shoulder height, elbows nearly straight. Taut cable passes from bar down between legs to low pulley behind body. Side three-quarter view.
